newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian wool indicator rises 7 cents to 640c/kg.
newsitem.headline: Australian wool indicator rises 7 cents to 640c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator rose a further seven cents to 640 cents a kg clean at sales in Sydney and Adelaide on Thursday, taking the indicator's rise this week to 14 cents, Wool International said.

All merino fleece indicators gained on Thursday, with 19/22/25/26 microns one percent dearer, 20/21m two percent dearer, 23/24 slightly dearer and merino skirtings of 19/20m one percent dearer, it said.
In crossbreds, 27/30m were 0.5 percent dearer, 28/29m up to one percent dearer, and 31m slightly dearer.
In cardings, locks were up to one percent cheaper and crutchings slightly cheaper.
WI said trading saw strong competition from China, Japan, local mills and Taiwan.
Of the 24,348 bales offered, six percent were passed in.
Sales continue next week in Sydney and Melbourne with about 56,600 bales to be offered.
